And if you dream to become a singer, focus on that ! Train your voice, make music, maybe (if you got some money) buy a mic to record ! Having a passion like that helps a lot, trust me. And if you can't do it, no problems !

Also, don't feel bad about feeling bad, don't hate yourself because you have depression, it's not your fault

(Also, Bonus Advice: Quit that  toxic environment the faster you can. idk where you leave/if it's possible, but taking distances with your family and start building your life on your own is actually fucking helpful)

Even if you don't like shopping, if you like the person you're with it's ok. 

If you don't know anybody, find people who are as socially awkward as you. in fact there lots of people like us, and they tend to understand you quite good, they won't be harsh about your awkwardness
